native_lifetimes: HF MLP evaluates gate_proj then act_fn, retains the silu value while evaluating up_proj, multiplies and calls down_proj.

Passive GPU capture borrows gate/up/silu storage and extends each original output lifetime until finite_decoder consumes all three; this differs from ordinary native eval where gate may die after act_fn.

PEFT keeps base result, casts x to LoRA_A dtype, and evaluates LoRA_A/LoRA_B/scaling/add. Scaling allocation happens before outer up_proj hook can capture its completed result; hooks on original LoRA_B can expose shape/dtype first.
